Specification: This module is a small test specification about record construction and record field access behavior, specifically focusing on an ill-typed access involving a newly constructed record. It defines a single top-level operator that creates a record, applies an EXCEPT update to a non-existent field, and then checks the resulting record domain. The file appears intended as a parser or typechecking test rather than a full transition-system model, and it contains no variables, actions, temporal specification, or fault model.
